# Hayakkom

> Hayakkom (Hayakom for Healthcare Solutions and Logistic Services) is an Egyptian company that coordinates medical treatment, dental care, hair restoration and cosmetic surgery in Egypt for patients travelling from Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait. It arranges pre-travel record review, appointments, transfers, accommodation and follow-up. Hayakkom is not a healthcare provider: treatment is delivered by independent licensed Egyptian doctors and hospitals.

Registered under Egyptian Law No. 159 of 1981. Commercial Register 49973. Unified Commercial Registry 11070-01000-49973. Sheikh Zayed City, District 16, Neighbourhood 2, Giza, Egypt. Bilingual Arabic and English. Contact support@hayakkom.com or WhatsApp +20 103 156 7949.

## Treatments

- [Hair transplant](https://www.hayakkom.com/hair-transplant): FUE, DHI and sapphire techniques. Price is set by graft count and technique; graft count is confirmed by the surgeon after examining the donor area. Typical stay 4–6 days.
- [Dental treatment](https://www.hayakkom.com/dental): implants, porcelain and composite veneers, Hollywood smile, All-on-4, crowns, whitening. Implant pricing varies widely with the implant system used. Implants usually need two trips of 3–5 days; veneers 5–7 days.
- [Weight-loss surgery](https://www.hayakkom.com/weight-loss): sleeve gastrectomy, gastric bypass, gastric balloon. Eligibility is assessed by the surgeon against BMI, associated conditions and fitness for anaesthesia. Typical stay 7–10 days including 1–2 hospital nights.
- [Cosmetic surgery](https://www.hayakkom.com/cosmetic-surgery): rhinoplasty, liposuction, abdominoplasty, breast surgery, blepharoplasty. Recovery, not operating time, sets the length of stay — usually 7–14 days before the surgeon clears the patient to fly.
- [Medical tourism](https://www.hayakkom.com/medical): specialist referrals, hospital appointments and treatment scheduling.
- [Wellness and recovery](https://www.hayakkom.com/wellness): post-operative recovery and rehabilitation stays.

## Markets

- [Saudi Arabia](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia): why Saudi patients travel to Egypt, routes, SAR pricing, the before/during/after journey, and ten Saudi-specific questions answered.
- [From Riyadh](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/riyadh): King Khalid International to Cairo, about 2h45–3h, flown daily by Saudia and EgyptAir.
- [From Jeddah](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/jeddah): King Abdulaziz International to Cairo, about 2h15 — the shortest route from Saudi Arabia and the most frequent.
- [From Dammam](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/dammam): King Fahd International to Cairo, about 3h, serving Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran and the Eastern Province.

## Knowledge base

- [About Hayakkom](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/about-hayakkom-who-we-are): legal identity, registered activities, and an explicit statement of what Hayakkom does not do.
- [Hair transplant costs in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/hair-transplant-egypt-cost-guide): why quoted prices range from about $1,000 to $8,500, how graft count is decided, and FUE compared with DHI, sapphire and FUT.
- [Dental implant costs in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/dental-implants-cost-egypt-saudi-patients): why published prices span 7,000 to 42,000 EGP, what is usually excluded, and how many trips are needed.
- [Bariatric surgery in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/bariatric-surgery-egypt-saudi-patients): eligibility criteria, complication risks including leak and nutritional deficiency, and the 10–20% rate of significant weight regain.
- [Recovery before flying home](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/cosmetic-surgery-egypt-how-long-before-flying): realistic stays by procedure and why flying too soon after surgery carries a blood-clot risk.
- [How long to stay in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/how-long-stay-egypt-medical-treatment): stay length for every treatment coordinated, and what can be completed before travelling.
- [Questions to ask before choosing a clinic abroad](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/questions-before-choosing-clinic-abroad): a twelve-question patient-safety checklist with the answers a patient should expect.

## Company

- [About](https://www.hayakkom.com/about): company information and legal identity.

- [Business services](https://www.hayakkom.com/business): medical conference organisation, marketing consultancy for healthcare providers, investment tourism and educational programmes.

## Optional

- [Healthcare partners](https://www.hayakkom.com/partners): As-Salam International Hospitals, Dar Al Fouad Hospitals, Alameda Healthcare, MGM Health & Wellness and The Zen Wellness Resort. Facility licensing and physician credentials are checked before any provider is listed.
- [Pricing policy](https://www.hayakkom.com/dental): indicative market ranges are published for orientation only, compiled from publicly published Egyptian clinic price lists. No final price is given before clinical assessment.
